categories.title: Added
list: Initial release. The Stretch tool grows only the side you drag, keeping the opposite face at the same coordinates. Alt restores centred stretch.

categories.title: Fixed
list: Halved the applied stretch in one-sided mode, so the dragged face lands where stock centred stretch would have put it instead of travelling twice as fast.
The cursor readout now shows the applied value rather than the raw one.

categories.title: Added
list: New setting **Keep Stretched Cubes Anchored When Resizing**.

categories.title: Fixed
list: Resizing a cube that already has stretch no longer moves the anchored face. Applies to the gizmo, the size sliders and keyboard nudges.

categories.title: Added
list: Added a **Stretch Tool Precision** divisor to slow the gizmo down.

categories.title: Added
list: New setting **Stretch per Drag Step**, defaulting to the format's base scale — 0.015625 for `hytale_character`, 0.03125 for `hytale_prop`. 0.125 reproduces stock.

categories.title: Changed
list: Replaced the drag maths outright: one unit of drag is one step of a fixed size, instead of stock's snapped-distance-times-an-eighth. Values now land on exact multiples and the tool no longer depends on the snapping settings or on how far you are zoomed out.

categories.title: Removed
list: Removed the **Stretch Tool Precision** divisor added in 1.3.0; a step size does the same job directly.

categories.title: Added
list: Shift, Ctrl and Ctrl+Shift while dragging cut the step to a half, a quarter and an eighth. Blockbench's snapping settings are still not used.

categories.title: Changed
list: Renamed from **One-Sided Stretch** to **Anchored Stretch**, since the plugin does three things rather than one. Behaviour is unchanged.
Plugin id and filename are now `anchored_stretch`.
Setting ids renamed to `anchored_stretch_tool`, `anchored_stretch_step`, `anchored_stretch_resize`, so settings reset to defaults on upgrade.

categories.title: Added
list: Vertex Snap gains a **Stretch** mode. Pick a corner, pick a target, and the cube stretches to reach it with the opposite corner anchored — on all three axes as needed. Core's scale mode is hidden in the Hytale formats (`condition: () => !Format.integer_size`) and would change the cube's size; stretching leaves size and UVs alone.
Supports the same ignore-axis amend options as the other snap modes. A target behind the anchored face clamps the stretch just above zero instead of inverting the cube.

categories.title: Added
list: Added a plugin icon, embedded as a data URL so the plugin stays a single file. `anchored_stretch_icon.png` is kept in the repo as the source.

categories.title: Changed
list: Updated the icon artwork, now 48x48.

categories.title: Added
list: A second Vertex Snap mode, Resize + Stretch. It closes the gap with whole units of size wherever it can and leaves stretch holding only the fraction that will not fit, so most of the face keeps genuine texture resolution. Stretch the cube already had is absorbed into whole units on the way through.
A Bake Stretch into Size button beside the stretch sliders. It rolls the stretch on every selected cube into whole units of size without moving the cubes on screen at all.

categories.title: Changed
list: Stretch from a vertex snap is rounded to six decimals. A gap that works out to a whole number now leaves the stretch at exactly 1 rather than 0.9999999990686774, and a real fraction reads as 1.025 instead of seventeen digits. The corner you snapped to lands within about a millionth of a unit.

categories.title: Fixed
list: Sizes produced by Resize + Stretch and by Bake Stretch into Size are exactly whole numbers. They could previously land a hair off, at 3.9999999999999996 rather than 4.
